label: Controls for the CREATURE_1 and CREATURE_2 senses
paraphrase: Closed controls on three explicit finite interpretations; statements about these interpretations only. (1) Three beings, all in act as to being, a causes b's being and nothing else is caused: b is CREATURE_2 and not CREATURE_1, so 'Whatever is CREATURE_2 is CREATURE_1' fails there, while 'Whatever has its being caused is in act as to being' holds and the Fourth-Way consequence (a maximum that causes the being of every other being and has no distinct cause of its being) fails. (2) Three beings, only a in act, b causes c's being: the Fourth-Way consequence holds (a is maximal, causes the being of every other being in act, vacuously, and is uncaused), 'Whatever has its being caused is in act as to being' fails and so does the CREATURE_2 to CREATURE_1 bridge. (3) Two beings, both in act, true causes false's being and false's esse is received: the Fourth-Way consequence, the weak premise, the bridge, 'The esse of every CREATURE_1 is received in some principle' and 'Whatever has its being caused by another has its esse received in some principle' all hold, and some being is caused (nonvacuity).
